text: Synthetic report. Objective: compare two document batching methods. Method: process 40 synthetic documents with batch size 4. The length-sorted method used 20 percent fewer padded input positions. This does not establish any GPU throughput improvement. Limitations: synthetic inputs, no CUDA measurements, and no factuality evaluation.

Synthetic report. Objective: evaluate cross-session memory. Method: reopen a local database after writing 100 events. All 100 events remained available. Limitations: one process and one local device; no distributed failure testing.
